name: Southern Cable Group Berhad
description: Malaysian cable manufacturer (Kuala Ketil and Sungai Petani, Kedah; listed on Bursa Malaysia) supplying low-voltage through high-voltage cables from 300 V to 132 kV, including XLPE medium and high-voltage power cables. Registered supplier to TNB, TM, SESB, Sarawak Energy and PETRONAS.
products: bare conductors and UL aluminium wires (export)

sources.note: Southern Cable site: 'we supply cables and wires from 300V up to 132kV', read 2026-11-13; TNB/TM/SESB/Sarawak Energy/PETRONAS customer list and Bursa listing from company disclosures cited in search summary
